ayahs.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
ayahs.tr: Qad aflahal mu'minoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
ayahs.en: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
ayahs.tr: Allazeena hum fee Salaatihim khaashi'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who turn away from ill speech
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum 'anillaghwimu'ridoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who are observant of zakah
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum liz Zakaati faa'iloon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who guard their private parts
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
ayahs.tr: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa innahum ghairu maloomeen

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
ayahs.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
ayahs.tr: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum li amaanaatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum 'alaa Salawaatihim yuhaafizoon

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.en: Those are the inheritors
ayahs.tr: Ulaaa'ika humul waarisoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.en: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.tr: Allazeena yarisoonal Firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim minteen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
ayahs.tr: Summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
ayahs.tr: Summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
ayahs.en: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
ayahs.tr: Summa innakum ba'da zaalika la maaiyitoon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
ayahs.tr: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati tub'asoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa wa maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen

ayahs.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
ayahs.tr: Wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi wa innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa diroon

ayahs.ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
ayahs.tr: Fa anshaanaa lakum bihee Jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
ayahs.tr: Wa shajaratan takhruju min Toori Sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni wa sibghil lil aakileen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.tr: Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
ayahs.tr: Wa 'alaihaa wa'alal fulki tuhmaloon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
ayahs.tr: Faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu ai yatafaddala 'alaikum wa law shaaa'al laahu la anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
ayahs.tr: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.en: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
ayahs.tr: Fa awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaat ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
ayahs.tr: Fa izas tawaita ata wa mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
ayahs.tr: Wa qur Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
ayahs.tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatinw wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.en: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
ayahs.tr: Summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen

ayahs.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.en: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
ayahs.tr: Fa arsalnaa feehim Rasoolam minhum ani'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
ayahs.en: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
ayahs.tr: Wa qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi liqaaa'il Aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
ayahs.tr: Wa la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon

ayahs.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
ayahs.en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
ayahs.tr: A-Ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum wa kuntum turaabanw wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon

ayahs.ar: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
ayahs.tr: Haihaata haihaata limaa too'adoon

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
ayahs.en: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.tr: In hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ooseen

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
ayahs.tr: In huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw wa maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
ayahs.tr: Qaala 'ammaa qaleelil la yusbihunna naadimeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
ayahs.tr: Fa akhazat humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw miz zaalimeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.en: Then We produced after them other generations.
ayahs.tr: Summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen

ayahs.ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
ayahs.en: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
ayahs.tr: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
ayahs.tr: Summa arsalnaa Rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar Rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw wa ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
ayahs.tr: Summa arsalnaa Moosaa wa akhaahu Haaroona bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
ayahs.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
ayahs.tr: Ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman 'aaleem

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
ayahs.tr: Faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
ayahs.en: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
ayahs.tr: Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanoo minal mmuhlakeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alnab na Maryama wa ummahooo aayatannw wa aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw wa ma'een

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.en: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
ayahs.tr: Yaaa aiyuhar Rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.en: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
ayahs.tr: Wa inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fattaqoon

ayahs.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
ayahs.en: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
ayahs.tr: Fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.en: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
ayahs.tr: Fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen

ayahs.ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.en: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
ayahs.tr: A-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mimmaalinw wa baneen

ayahs.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.en: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
ayahs.tr: Nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
ayahs.tr: Innal lazeena hum min khashyati Rabbihim mushfiqoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum bi Aayaati Rabbihim yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum bi Rabbihim laa yushrikoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa Rabbihim raaji'oon

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
ayahs.tr: Ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.tr: Wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi w ahum la yuzlamoon

ayahs.ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.en: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
ayahs.tr: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa wa lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
ayahs.en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaaa akhznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon

ayahs.ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.en: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
ayahs.tr: Laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon

ayahs.ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
ayahs.en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
ayahs.tr: Qad kaanat Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon

ayahs.ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
ayahs.en: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
ayahs.tr: Mustakbireena bihee saamiran tahjuroon

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
ayahs.tr: Afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
ayahs.tr: Am lam ya'rifoo Rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi wa aksaruhum lil haqqi kaarihoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.en: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
ayahs.tr: Wa lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal ardu wa man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
ayahs.tr: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju Rabbika khairunw wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.en: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
ayahs.tr: Wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
ayahs.en: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
ayahs.tr: Wa innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.en: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
ayahs.tr: Wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
ayahs.en: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famastakaanoo li Rabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
ayahs.en: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazeee ansha a-lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon

ayahs.ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
ayahs.tr: Bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab 'oosoon

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.tr: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
ayahs.tr: Qul limanil ardu wa man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
ayahs.tr: Sa-yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tazakkkaroon

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
ayahs.tr: Qul mar Rabbus samaawaatis sab'i wa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
ayahs.tr: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tattaqoon

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
ayahs.tr: Qul mam bi yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw wa Huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
ayahs.tr: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul fa annaa tus haroon

ayahs.ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.en: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
ayahs.tr: Bal atainaahum bil haqqi wa innahum lakaaziboon

ayahs.ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.en: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
ayahs.tr: Mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw wa maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wa la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; Subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
ayahs.tr: 'Aalimil Ghaibi wash shahhaadati fata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

ayahs.ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
ayahs.tr: Qur Rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.tr: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
ayahs.tr: Wa innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon

ayahs.ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.en: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
ayahs.tr: Idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayahs.en: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
ayahs.tr: Wa qur Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen

ayahs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
ayahs.en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
ayahs.tr: Wa a'oozu bika Rabbi ai-yahduroon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
ayahs.en: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada humul mawtu qaala Rabbir ji'oon

ayahs.ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.tr: La'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa wa minw waraaa'him barzakhun ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.en: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
ayahs.tr: Fa izaa nufikha fis Soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw wa laa yatasaaa'aloon

ayahs.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
ayahs.en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
ayahs.tr: Faman saqulat mawaazee nuhoo fa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.en: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
ayahs.tr: Wa man khaffat mawaa zeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroon anfusahum fee Jahannnama khaalidoon

ayahs.ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
ayahs.en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
ayahs.tr: Talfahu wujoohahumun Naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihood

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.en: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
ayahs.tr: Alam takun Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo Rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daaalleen

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.en: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
ayahs.tr: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa in 'udnaa fa innaa zaalimoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
ayahs.en: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
ayahs.tr: Qaalakh sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
ayahs.tr: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khairur raahimeen

ayahs.ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
ayahs.tr: Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon

ayahs.ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
ayahs.tr: Inee jazaituhumul Yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon

ayahs.ar: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
ayahs.tr: Qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen

ayahs.ar: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
ayahs.tr: Qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
ayahs.tr: Afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw wa annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon

ayahs.ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.en: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
ayahs.tr: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Kareem

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
ayahs.tr: Wa mai yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa innnamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda Rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
ayahs.tr: Wa qur Rabbigh fir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen
